chunks: God advances the example of Noah's wife and the wife of Lot for those who do not believe. They were married to Our two pious devotees, but they were unfaithful to them, and even (the apostles) could not avail them in the least against God; and it was said to them: "Enter Hell with those (who are condemned) to enter it."

key_terms.فَخَانَاهُمَا: But they were unfaithful to them

ai.seo_question: Why were the wives of the Prophets Nuh and Lut condemned to Hell despite being married to them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle that spiritual merit is individual and not transferable through lineage or marriage, even to the highest-ranking Prophets. It serves as a stern warning against hypocrisy, illustrating that the intercession of the righteous is limited to those who possess their own sincere faith, thereby emphasizing personal accountability in the face of divine judgment.
